summary: TENSOR-SPEC-CERT-1.0 provides an exemplary, zero-floating-point algebraic certificate framework and Lean 4.35.0 formal kernel verifying core finite-dimensional algebraic, exterior-algebra, CAT(0) metric, mean-width, and catalyst invariants for OpenAI's tensor asymptotic spectrum preprint. Through 19 machine-checked theorems, 16 verified canonical certificates, and rigorous adversarial testing, the work achieves exceptionally high standards of formal rigor and reproducibility.
weaknesses: Some advanced infinite-dimensional aspects of the underlying preprint (such as pointed ultralimits and Hahn-Banach triangle-density arguments) are necessarily deferred from the formal Lean kernel due to finite-dimensional scope boundaries.
